testing_attributes.rule: All interactive, navigation, form, modal, theme toggle, and CTA elements MUST contain specific kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject google fonts (Syne, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono) into public/index.html or top of index.css
Set up CSS variable theme system in index.css with .dark class toggling background/foreground/accent/border values
Install and integrate Lenis for smooth momentum scroll throughout the app (`yarn add @studio-freight/lenis` or custom smooth scroll wrapper)
Implement Sonner toast notification on contact form submission and email copy action
Ensure WhatsApp click-to-chat links open in new tab (`target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'`) with encoded pre-filled message
Ensure mobile responsive nav drawer works seamlessly with theme toggle
Make sure every interactive element has data-testid attribute
